tools.description:
OperationId: companySearch.

Company search.

USE THIS WHEN:
- Company search.
- Search for companies using filters.
- Find matching entities with structured filters and pagination.

DO NOT USE FOR:
- Finding individual people (use peopleSearch)
- Getting contact info like email (use syncContactEnrichment after finding profile)

EXAMPLE:
Input: companySearch_tool(searchParams={}, pageSize=123)

INPUT SCHEMA:
Required parameters:
  - searchParams (object): Search parameters for company search API.
    Properties: ['exactCompanyV2', 'domains', 'headquartersCountryCode', 'headquartersStateName', 'employeeCountV2', 'keywords', 'industriesV2', 'stage', 'totalFundingUSD', 'lastFundingUSD', 'lastFundedOn', 'foundedOn', 'nameLike', 'exactCompany', 'acceleratorsV2', 'headquartersLocation', 'linkedinSlugs', 'specialFlags', 'employees', 'naicsCodes', 'fortuneRankings', 'jobPostingsV2', 'jobPostingStats', 'officeLocationsV2', 'tlds', 'numWordsInName', 'status', 'technologies', 'crunchbaseCategories', 'crunchbaseCategoryGroups', 'crunchbaseSlugs', 'investorsV2', 'technologiesV2', 'revenueRangeUSD', 'employeeTrendsV2', 'tags', 'linke...

apiKey.description: Your Fiber API key. Optional if you provide it via mcp.json headers (x-api-key / x-apikey / Authorization: Bearer).

companyExclusionListIDs.description: The IDs of company exclusion lists to filter out matching companies.

cursor.description: A pagination cursor returned from a previous search response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.

includeCount.description: When true, returns an estimated total count of matching companies in the response. The count does not account for exclusion lists.

pageSize.description: The number of companies to return per page.

searchParams.description: Search parameters for company search API.

tools.name: companySearch_tool
tools.title: Company Search

      - startedInRole (any)
      - startedAtCompany (any)
      - location (['object', 'null'])
      - languages (['object', 'null'])
      - leftSt...

apiKey.description: Your Fiber API key. Optional if you provide it via mcp.json headers (x-api-key / x-apikey / Authorization: Bearer).

companyExclusionListIDs.description: Filter out people who work at companies which belong to the given company exclusion lists

currentCompanies.description: Filter people by the companies they are currently working for. If you want to search over many companies, we suggest using the Combined Search API, which is optimized for this use case.

cursor.description: A pagination cursor returned from a previous search response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.

includeCount.description: When true, returns an estimated total count of matching prospects in the response. The count does not account for exclusion lists.

pageSize.description: The number of profiles to return, if you need to get more results, you can paginate.

prospectExclusionListIDs.description: Filter out people which belong to the given prospect exclusion lists

tools.description:
OperationId: profileLiveEnrich.

Live fetch LinkedIn profile.

USE THIS WHEN:
- Live fetch LinkedIn profile.
- Returns an enriched profile with details (work experience, education, skills, location, etc.) for a given LinkedIn profile identifier. **Note:** This endpoint does NOT return emails or phone numbers. To retrieve a person's contact details (emails and phone numbers), use the `POST /contact-details/single` endpoint (synchronous, recommended) or the `POST /individual-reveal/start` + `POST /individual-reveal/poll` pair (asynchronous). These can be found under the **Contact details** section.
- Fetch fresh upstream profile/company/activity data.

DO NOT USE FOR:
- Batch operations (use search or batch APIs instead)

EXAMPLE:
Input: profileLiveEnrich_tool(identifier="example_string", getDetailedEducation="example")

INPUT SCHEMA:
Required parameters:
  - identifier (string): The profile's LinkedIn slug (e.g. 'williamhgates'), full LinkedIn URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates/'), Sales Navigator URN, or LinkedIn user ID (e.g. '443105112').
Optional parameters:
  - getDetailedEducation (['boolean', 'nu...

apiKey.description: Your Fiber API key. Optional if you provide it via mcp.json headers (x-api-key / x-apikey / Authorization: Bearer).

getDetailedEducation.description: Whether to include deep details about each educational item, like the school's LinkedIn URL, website, location, etc. That'll be put in the detailedEducation array. This slows down the API call, so only enable this if you need it.

getDetailedWorkExperience.description: Whether to include deep details about each work experience item, like the company's LinkedIn URL, website, location, etc. That'll be put in the detailedWorkExperience array. This slows down the API call, so only enable this if you need it.

identifier.description: The profile's LinkedIn slug (e.g. 'williamhgates'), full LinkedIn URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates/'), Sales Navigator URN, or LinkedIn user ID (e.g. '443105112').

tools.title: Profile Live Enrich

tools.description:
OperationId: companyLiveEnrich.

Live fetch LinkedIn company.

USE THIS WHEN:
- Live fetch LinkedIn company.
- Returns an enriched company with details for a given LinkedIn company identifier.
- Fetch fresh upstream profile/company/activity data.

DO NOT USE FOR:
- Batch operations (use search or batch APIs instead)

EXAMPLE:
Input: companyLiveEnrich_tool(type="example_string", value="example_string")

INPUT SCHEMA:
Required parameters:
  - type (string): 
  - value (string): The company's LinkedIn slug (e.g. 'microsoft'), LinkedIn URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft'), LinkedIn organization ID (e.g. '1441'), or Fiber company ID (e.g. 'comp_1441').
Optional parameters:
  - getHistoricalHeadcount (boolean): Whether to compute the company's overall employee count over time and recent growth trends. This returns total headcount through time, not a per-department breakdown — for per-department headcount, use the Depth Chart endpoints. No additional cost, but may take longer.

RETURNS:
Response object with keys: output, chargeInfo, warnings, advice

apiKey.description: Your Fiber API key. Optional if you provide it via mcp.json headers (x-api-key / x-apikey / Authorization: Bearer).

getHistoricalHeadcount.description: Whether to compute the company's overall employee count over time and recent growth trends. This returns total headcount through time, not a per-department breakdown — for per-department headcount, use the Depth Chart endpoints. No additional cost, but may take longer.

type.description: type input parameter (string). Call get_endpoint_details_full for nested shape details.

value.description: The company's LinkedIn slug (e.g. 'microsoft'), LinkedIn URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft'), LinkedIn organization ID (e.g. '1441'), or Fiber company ID (e.g. 'comp_1441').

OperationId: getAllApiKeys.

List API keys.

USE THIS WHEN:
- List API keys.
- List all API keys for your organization, including each key's name, prefix, expiration, and per-key credit usage. The secret value of a key is only shown once at creation and is never returned here.

EXAMPLE:
Input: getAllApiKeys_tool(includeRevoked=True)

INPUT SCHEMA:
Required parameters:
Optional parameters:
  - includeRevoked (boolean): Include revoked keys in the results. Defaults to false, returning only active keys.

RETURNS:
Response object with keys: output, chargeInfo, warnings, advice
